## `worklouderctl`

```text
worklouderctl 0.1.0
Full-configuration CLI for Codex Micro, Codex, and Work Louder Input

USAGE:
    worklouderctl [OPTIONS] <SUBCOMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Print help information
        --json       Emit machine-readable JSON when the command supports it
    -V, --version    Print version information

SUBCOMMANDS:
    action           Inspect or edit Actions in an offline configuration snapshot
    agent            Validate or execute a shell-free JSON command envelope for agents
    appsense         Inspect or edit AppSense linked applications in an offline snapshot
    backup           Verify backup integrity and report version migration requirements
    bridge           Inspect the Input Companion Bridge transport
    capability       Inspect capabilities covered by the CLI contract
    cheat-sheet      Inspect or bind Input Cheat Sheet behaviors in an offline snapshot
    codex            Inspect or export Codex-owned Codex Micro settings
    compatibility    Inspect the release-gated application, bridge, and firmware matrix
    completion       Generate a shell completion script on standard output
    config           Validate or compare exported configuration
    control          Inspect or edit physical controls in an offline configuration snapshot
    device           Read live Codex Micro state through Input or its compatibility provider
    doctor           Diagnose Codex, Input, and cached device configuration providers
    help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
    input            Inspect or export Input-owned configuration
    layer            Inspect or edit layers in an offline configuration snapshot
    multi-action     Inspect or edit Multi Actions in an offline configuration snapshot
    preset           Inspect, preview, or install Input layer presets
    profile          Inspect or edit profiles in an offline configuration snapshot
    radial           Inspect the Input-hosted joystick radial menu without opening its window
    schema           Discover the versioned JSON Schemas used by automation clients
    smart-action     Inspect or edit Input-hosted Smart Actions in an offline snapshot
    tier             Inspect the configuration authority tiers
    transaction      Plan coordinated Codex and Input mutations with one unified diff
    version          Print CLI version information
```

## `worklouderctl device`

```text
worklouderctl-device 0.1.0
Read live Codex Micro state through Input or its compatibility provider

        --app <APP>
            Override the Work Louder Input application bundle path

            Coordinate access when the Input app currently owns the device [default: require-closed]
            [possible values: require-closed, restart]

        --json
            Emit machine-readable JSON when the command supports it

            Select the Input-owned bridge or the direct compatibility provider [default: auto]
            [possible values: auto, bridge, direct]

    -V, --version
            Print version information

SUBCOMMANDS:
    config    Snapshot or validate configuration through Input's live session
    export    Export exact live device files into a verified atomic bundle
    files     List files on the live device filesystem without changing them
    help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
    status    Read firmware, active profile/layer, and power state from the device
```

```text
worklouderctl-multi-action-group-member-add 0.1.0
Append an existing Multi Action to a group

USAGE:
    worklouderctl multi-action group member add [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT> --id <ID> --multi-action <MULTI_ACTION> --output <OUTPUT>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                           Print help information
        --id <ID>
        --input <INPUT>
        --json                           Emit machine-readable JSON when the command supports it
        --multi-action <MULTI_ACTION>
        --output <OUTPUT>
    -V, --version                        Print version information
```

## `worklouderctl multi-action group member move`

```text
worklouderctl-multi-action-group-member-move 0.1.0
Move one member by zero-based index

USAGE:
    worklouderctl multi-action group member move [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT> --id <ID> --from <FROM> --to <TO> --output <OUTPUT>

OPTIONS:
        --from <FROM>
    -h, --help               Print help information
        --id <ID>
        --input <INPUT>
        --json               Emit machine-readable JSON when the command supports it
        --output <OUTPUT>
        --to <TO>
    -V, --version            Print version information
```

## `worklouderctl multi-action group member remove`

```text
worklouderctl-multi-action-group-member-remove 0.1.0
Remove a Multi Action from a group while keeping the resource itself

USAGE:
    worklouderctl multi-action group member remove [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT> --id <ID> --multi-action <MULTI_ACTION> --output <OUTPUT>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                           Print help information
        --id <ID>
        --input <INPUT>
        --json                           Emit machine-readable JSON when the command supports it
        --multi-action <MULTI_ACTION>
        --output <OUTPUT>
    -V, --version                        Print version information
```
